related_papers.title: Particulate air pollution undermines plant water-use efficiency by inhibiting photosynthesis
related_papers.summary: The influence of fine particulate pollution (PM 2.5 ) on plant water-use efficiency remains poorly understood. The authors highlight that PM 2.5 exerts a primarily negative effect across scales due to asymmetric effects on photosynthesis and evapotranspiration.

related_papers.title: Failure to track a stable AMOC state under rapid climate change
related_papers.summary: Climate change is expected to alter oceanic circulation, with the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) at risk of collapse. This work shows that the stability of the AMOC is dependent on the rate of atmospheric CO 2 change rather than having a fixed threshold.
